ValidationRule.description: Invoice number must be INV-YYYY-NNNNNN, year must equal the issue year, and the digit sum parity must be even (a mod-2 check on the first and last digits).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Invoice_Number__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(Invoice_Number__c, 'INV-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{6}')), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Issue_Date__c)), VALUE(MID(Invoice_Number__c, 5, 4)) <> YEAR(Issue_Date__c)), IF(REGEX(Invoice_Number__c, 'INV-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{6}'), MOD(VALUE(MID(Invoice_Number__c, 10, 1)) + VALUE(RIGHT(Invoice_Number__c, 1)), 2) <> 0, FALSE) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Number has a bad format, year, or check digit.
